transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble sitting through things. Like at work, during sprint planning... or even just on mortgage calls recently. 

I just keep getting up. Even when I know I really should stay put, I'll... I don't know, suddenly decide I need water, or I'll just go check something in the other room. So... yeah. That's why I made the appointment.
Did you experience similar difficulty sitting still or feeling restless when you were a child?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. I remember in elementary school... teachers would sometimes have to move my desk. Or they'd have to remind me to just stay seated. 

I guess I was always popping up. And... I don't know, I'd talk before I was called on, or just rush through my work, even if I actually understood it. So... yeah.
Besides having trouble sitting still, do you also find it difficult to stay focused on tasks or conversations?

Um... yeah, a little bit. Like if I need to review a pull request at work, or... look over those mortgage documents. 

I'll start out meaning to get through it, but then after a few minutes, I'll realize I'm just staring at the exact same section. My mind just sort of goes off to... I don't know, five other unrelated things. So... yeah.
